description: Plays a composition on the user's stage from the first frame to the last, through the same preview a person watches (which inspect_composition does not use), and reports whether it got to the end. Buffering is allowed; any error ends the run. Answers within about 20 s: {status:"running", at, total} means call again with the same id to keep waiting on the same run. Then {status:"done", verdict:"ok"|"problems", problems, warnings} or {status:"incomplete", reason} (tab hidden, interrupted, edited). It takes over the stage while it runs: the composition under test becomes the one on screen and the preview plays from frame 0. The composition's source and props are not changed.

token.description: The session token that connect returned.
